mechanism: Cimetidine reduces renal clearance of tobramycin by decreasing glomerular filtration and competing for active tubular secretion, leading to increased aminoglycoside accumulation and nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum tobramycin levels closely, assess renal function regularly, and consider alternative H2-blockers (famotidine, ranitidine) if possible; ensure adequate hydration and appropriate dosing intervals based on renal function.
